condition: Proposal submission is restricted to a single PDF of at most 20 pages, due by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC (SRC-0015).
event: The final assembled proposal exceeds 20 pages or the upload is delayed past 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.
effect: The proposal is rejected outright without evaluation.
assumptions: The team can format all required technical and pricing details within 20 pages.
trigger: Draft proposal exceeds 18 pages one week before the deadline, or portal upload is attempted less than 4 hours before 12:00 UTC.
responses: Enforce a strict 18-page budget for the draft to leave a two-page safety margin.
Perform a dry-run upload of a dummy PDF via the procurement portal one week prior to the deadline.
residual_exposure: A technical portal outage during the final upload window.

condition: The service must go live by 2027-01-11 for spring enrollment, leaving only 41 calendar days from the bid deadline of 2026-12-01 (SRC-0032).
event: Integration, testing, or user acceptance delays push the deployment past the spring enrollment start date.
effect: Students cannot sign enrollment documents digitally during the peak spring enrollment period.
assumptions: Contract award and mobilization happen immediately upon bid submission without negotiation delays.
trigger: API integration testing is not completed two weeks before the go-live date.
responses: Pre-build and test the student records system REST API integration connector during the bid phase before formal award.
Establish a fallback manual paper signing process for spring enrollment day if the digital service launch slips.
residual_exposure: Student friction and manual administrative overhead if the go-live date is missed.

condition: The migration of signed records held in the current tool is scheduled for completion by 2027-02-28 (SRC-0026), which is after the go-live date of 2027-01-11 (SRC-0032).
event: Students or staff require access to historical signed records during the gap between go-live and migration completion, but the records are still trapped in the legacy tool.
effect: Inability to reference past documents leads to administrative compliance failures and user confusion.
assumptions: Users will not need access to historical records during the transition period.
trigger: A support ticket requests a historical record stored in the legacy tool during January 2027.
responses: Accelerate the migration of signed records to finish prior to the 2027-01-11 go-live date.
Provide designated staff with read-only access to the legacy tool until migration is fully complete.
residual_exposure: Dual-system lookup overhead for staff during the transition period.
